# Index Exchange
> Global supply-side platform helping publishers, app developers, marketers, agencies, and DSPs grow revenue and reach consumers across every screen.

Index Exchange provides ad technology solutions focused on exchange efficiency, quality, transparency, addressability, programmatic deals, and omnichannel monetization for digital media businesses worldwide.

## Platform
- [Platform Overview](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/): Overview of Index Exchange’s supply-side platform capabilities and core ad technology solutions.
- [Exchange Efficiency](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/exchange-efficiency/): Explains tools and infrastructure designed to improve auction performance and operational efficiency.
- [Exchange Quality](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/exchange-quality/): Describes quality controls, protections, and standards for healthier programmatic marketplaces.
- [Exchange Transparency](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/exchange-transparency/): Details transparency features that help participants understand auction dynamics and outcomes.
- [Addressability Portfolio](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/addressability-portfolio/): Covers identity and addressability solutions for privacy-conscious audience activation.
- [Channels and Formats](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/channels-formats/): Summarizes supported media channels and ad formats across digital environments.
- [Data and Analytics](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/data-analytics/): Highlights reporting, measurement, and analytics capabilities for platform participants.
- [Programmatic Deals](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/programmatic-deals/): Explains deal-based buying and selling workflows within the platform.
- [Index Marketplaces](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/index-marketplaces/): Describes curated marketplace offerings for more controlled programmatic transactions.

## Solutions by Audience
- [Solutions Overview](https://www.indexexchange.com/solutions/): Entry point for Index Exchange solutions tailored to different market participants.
- [Publishers](https://www.indexexchange.com/solution/publishers/): Solutions for publishers seeking revenue growth, yield optimization, and operational control.
- [Streaming TV Publishers](https://www.indexexchange.com/solution/streaming-tv-publishers/): Monetization solutions built for streaming TV inventory owners and broadcasters.
- [App Developers](https://www.indexexchange.com/solution/app-developers/): Tools and marketplace access for mobile and in-app monetization.
- [Marketers and Agencies](https://www.indexexchange.com/solution/marketers-agencies/): Buying solutions for advertisers and agencies seeking quality omnichannel supply.
- [DSPs](https://www.indexexchange.com/solution/dsps/): Integration and marketplace solutions for demand-side platforms.
- [Partners and Integrations](https://www.indexexchange.com/solution/partners-integrations/): Information for technology partners and integrated ecosystem participants.

## Key Capabilities
- [Streaming TV Publishers](https://www.indexexchange.com/solution/streaming-tv-publishers/): Focused solution page for streaming TV monetization and inventory management.
- [Programmatic Deals](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/programmatic-deals/): Deal execution options for private, preferred, and curated transactions.
- [Index Marketplaces](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/index-marketplaces/): Curated environments for buyers and sellers seeking greater control and quality.
- [Addressability Portfolio](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/addressability-portfolio/): Identity and privacy-oriented tools supporting audience addressability across channels.
- [Channels and Formats](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/channels-formats/): Coverage of supported screens, environments, and creative formats.
- [Data and Analytics](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/data-analytics/): Measurement and reporting features for optimization and decision-making.

## Trust, Quality, and Transparency
- [Exchange Quality](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/exchange-quality/): Marketplace quality standards and controls for safer, more effective transactions.
- [Exchange Transparency](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/exchange-transparency/): Visibility into platform mechanics, fees, and auction behavior.
- [Exchange Efficiency](https://www.indexexchange.com/platform/exchange-efficiency/): Performance-focused infrastructure supporting efficient programmatic trading.
- [Partners and Integrations](https://www.indexexchange.com/solution/partners-integrations/): Ecosystem relationships that extend interoperability and platform reliability.
